name: SwipeAction
summary: Mobile-only row wrapper that exposes trailing (and optionally leading) actions on horizontal swipe. iOS-flavor — swipe left reveals Delete (red), Archive (neutral), or custom actions; rubberband resistance past the action width. Distinct from desktop right-click context menus (use DropdownMenu trigger='context').

trailing.description: Array of SwipeAction items revealed on swipe-left. Each: { id, label, icon, tone (neutral/danger), onSelect, fullSwipe? }. fullSwipe=true triggers the action when the user swipes past the full row width.

leading.description: Array revealed on swipe-right. Use for opposite-meaning actions (Mark unread, Flag).

snapDistance.description: Px width to settle each revealed action at. The swipe snaps to multiples of this.

fullSwipeAction.description: id of the trailing action that's auto-fired on full-distance swipe (typically Delete).

keyboard: ArrowRight - reveal leading actions / close trailing
Enter / Space - activate the first revealed action
Action 1 (number key) - activate first action, 2 = second, etc.
rules: Per WCAG 2.5.7 — every swipe action MUST also be reachable without dragging. Render a Tap-to-reveal IconButton on the row (or trigger via long-press → ActionSheet).
Each revealed action is a button with aria-label='{Verb} {context}' — 'Delete conversation', 'Archive Sterling LTL invoice'.
Rubberband resistance prevents over-swipe; the snap distance keeps actions discoverable without committing.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: snap to discrete positions without the elastic ease.

do: Pair every swipe action with a non-drag alternative — a long-press menu or visible IconButton row.
Order trailing actions from least-destructive (left, near edge) to most-destructive (right, full swipe).
Use fullSwipeAction='delete' for inbox-style archive/delete patterns.
Animate the snap with decelerate easing, not bounce.
Render the action icon + label in the revealed surface; not just the icon.
dont: Don't use SwipeAction on desktop. Use a DropdownMenu trigger='context' (right-click).
Don't pack more than 3 trailing actions per row.
Don't use SwipeAction for non-row-scoped destructive actions ('Delete account') — those go in a Dialog.
Don't omit the non-drag fallback — WCAG 2.5.7 failure.

changelog.note: Initial SwipeAction contract. iOS-flavor with rubberband + snap. WCAG 2.5.7 non-drag fallback required.
